spec.hypothesis: Hybrid filter+reweight: remove q>0.95, then adaptive reweight remainder. Combines detect_remove's elimination of worst samples with adaptive's soft reweighting. Data: 253,584 rows (from 371,499).

experiment_data.hypothesis: Hybrid filter+reweight (remove q>0.95 then adaptive reweight remainder with rho=0.4) will achieve lower holdout PPL than pure adaptive reweighting by eliminating the most contaminated samples before soft reweighting, combining the strengths of detect_remove and adaptive methods.
